name: terminal-gym
description: Claude Gym: a daily rep goal inside Claude Code. Log with /fit, quick-log band, long-turn nudges, streaks and a score grid, optional strict mode.

nudges.title: Long-turn nudges
nudges.description: Suggest a set when a turn runs long.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Long turns add rep debt; new prompts are held until it is paid (/fit skip breaks your streak instead).

nudgeSeconds.title: Nudge after (seconds)
nudgeSeconds.description: How long a turn runs before Claude Gym suggests a set.

nudgeReps.title: Reps per nudge
nudgeReps.description: Reps suggested (and owed, in strict mode) per long turn.

spinner.title: Spinner takeover
spinner.description: Replace the spinner word with the suggested set during long turns.

band.title: Quick-log band
band.description: Show progress and +5/+10/+25 buttons above the prompt.
